what: Shomer OS flash plan: the ONE source of truth for what gets written to a phone. The flasher (Shomer-TCL/shomer-flasher, mkbundle -flash-plan) refuses to build if its partition list, order, flags or stock vbmeta checksums differ from this file; the image release and the image README print it.
relock: never (a locked bootloader with this system = no boot)

write_order.fastboot: fastboot flash super super.raw   (if the bootloader refuses: fastboot reboot fastboot, then the same command in fastbootd)

why_all_three_vbmeta: Stock KEKA vbmeta has flags 0 and chains boot, vbmeta_system (system+product hashtrees) and vbmeta_vendor (vendor). Shomer's system and product no longer match those hashtrees. The top-level vbmeta with both flags is what turns verification and dm-verity off (libavb skips chained partitions once the top level says verification disabled); the same flags on vbmeta_system and vbmeta_vendor are redundant but harmless on an unlocked phone and match the procedure TCL Flip 2 ROM guides use (apps4flip kosher-ROM guide). The images are the untouched stock KEKA files; only fastboot sets the flag bits while writing. Decided Nov 2 2026 (full review) to end the Oct 30 disagreement between the image review (vbmeta only) and the flasher (all three).

optional.when: only on a phone that was ALREADY unlocked, and only if the person says yes (unlocking itself wipes the phone)

never_written: recovery (except the two pinned backup_first writes: recovery2 then genuine stock)
after_flashing: The phone shows the 'orange state' unlocked warning for 5 s at every boot (bootloader text, cannot be changed). Add the phone's IMEI in the admin portal before or after; it syncs at first boot.

backup_first.what: Backup-first (Shomer flasher 1.4.0+, on by default, --no-backup skips it): BEFORE write_order, the flasher writes neutronscott's recovery2.img to recovery, restarts into it, reads every partition (except RPMB) over adb into backup-<serial>-<date>.zip on the PC (sha256 per partition on the phone and on the PC, then the whole zip re-read), returns to fastboot and writes the GENUINE stock TCL KEKA recovery back. These two pinned writes are the ONLY writes to recovery; write_order never contains it. mkbundle refuses to build if this section is missing or names other bytes.
backup_first.default: on (--no-backup skips the backup and never touches recovery)

recovery_writes.image: recovery2.img (neutronscott, http://scottn.us/downloads/recovery2.img; same bytes as shomer-images stock/KEKA/recovery, which is NOT stock)
recovery_writes.fastboot: fastboot flash recovery recovery2.img, then fastboot reboot recovery
recovery_writes.why: read-only dump tool: TCL KEE7 recovery + Magisk su + busybox, adb without a prompt; fastboot boot does not work on this bootloader, so it has to be written

recovery_writes.image: stock-recovery-KEKA.img (genuine stock TCL T408DL KEKA recovery, rebuilt from stock KEKA boot + /vendor/recovery-from-boot.p by shomer-flasher tools/make-stock-recovery.py; SHA-1 40e9d0d4bc1e10efa308e9a279f70b2300ff9200 as in the phone's own install-recovery.sh; also in shomer-images stock/KEKA/recovery-genuine)
recovery_writes.why: always written back, on success and on every failure path (recovery2 gives a root shell to anyone with a USB cable); --restore-recovery does only this step

backup_first.reads: every partition listed in /dev/block/by-name except rpmb; userdata only with --backup-userdata on a phone that was already unlocked
backup_first.fail_closed: if a critical partition (proinfo/IMEI, nvram, nvdata, nvcfg, persist, protect1/2, seccfg, md1img, boot, vendor_boot, dtbo, lk, logo, vbmeta*, super, ...) cannot be read and verified: no flash, stock recovery written back, no half zip kept
